- `rfc9529_trace1.json`, `rfc9529_trace2.json`: the values printed in RFC 9529,
  Sections 2 (method 0, cipher suite 0) and 3 (method 3, cipher suite 2),
  keyed by the label the RFC prints above each value. Where a label appears
  twice, the later value is kept, so in trace 2 `message_1` is the one sent
  after cipher suite negotiation.
